    @pytest.mark.usefixtures("genportal_config")
    def test_registracionusuarioVivabioma(driver):
        kit_code = "QA2TSCBA2827"
        preparar_kit_para_registro(kit_code)
        preparar_kit_vivabioma(kit_code)
        email, token = crear_email_temporal()
        wait = WebDriverWait(driver, 20)
        viva_web = get_config("VIVA_WEB", "https://app.vivabioma.com")
    
        abrir_pagina(driver, f"{viva_web}/create-account?lang=es")
    
        def set_input(name, val):
            inp = wait.until(lambda d: d.find_element(By.NAME, name))
            driver.execute_script("arguments[0].scrollIntoView({block:'center'});", inp)
            driver.execute_script(
                "arguments[0].value = arguments[1]; "
                "arguments[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); "
                "arguments[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true}));",
                inp, val
            )
    
        # Paso 1: Datos personales
        set_input("firstName", "PRUEBA")
        set_input("lastName", "PRUEBA")
        set_input("password", "Test12345!")
        set_input("password2", "Test12345!")
        set_input("email", email)
        set_input("email2", email)
    
        # Selector de País
        c_select = wait.until(lambda d: d.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, ".viva-country-select .v-field"))
        driver.execute_script("arguments[0].scrollIntoView({block:'center'});", c_select)
        c_select.click()
        time.sleep(1)
        items = [el for el in driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, ".v-overlay--active .v-list-item") if el.is_displayed()]
        for it in items:
            if "españ" in it.text.lower() or "spain" in it.text.lower():
                driver.execute_script("arguments[0].click();", it)
                break
        else:
            if items:
                driver.execute_script("arguments[0].click();", items[0])
    
        time.sleep(1)
        set_input("province", "Valencia")
        set_input("city", "Valencia")
        set_input("street", "Calle Falsa")
        set_input("number", "123")
        set_input("postalCode", "46700")
        set_input("phoneNumber", "611586634")
    
        # Checkbox marketing
        chk = driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, "input[type='checkbox']")
        driver.execute_script("arguments[0].click();", chk)
        time.sleep(1)
    
        # Botón Siguiente a paso 2
        btn_next = wait.until(lambda d: d.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, "button.bg-primary"))
        driver.execute_script("arguments[0].click();", btn_next)
    
        # Paso 2: Datos del kit
        wait.until(lambda d: d.find_elements(By.NAME, "kitBarcode"))
        set_input("kitBarcode", kit_code)
    
        # Radios (Sexo al nacer y Tipo de usuario)
        radio_male = wait.until(lambda d: d.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, "input[type='radio'][value='male']"))
        driver.execute_script("arguments[0].click();", radio_male)
    
        radio_adult = wait.until(lambda d: d.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, "input[type='radio'][value='ADULT']"))
        driver.execute_script("arguments[0].click();", radio_adult)
    
        # Desplegables de Fecha de nacimiento (Año -> Mes -> Día)
        def select_date_viva(keyword, index=0):
            for s in driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, ".viva__select"):
                if keyword.lower() in (s.text or "").lower():
                    field = s.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, ".v-field")
                    driver.execute_script("arguments[0].scrollIntoView({block:'center'});", field)
                    field.click()
                    time.sleep(1)
                    opts = [o for o in driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, ".v-overlay--active .v-list-item") if o.is_displayed()]
                    if opts:
                        driver.execute_script("arguments[0].click();", opts[min(index, len(opts)-1)])
                    time.sleep(0.5)
                    break
    
        select_date_viva("Año", index=30)
        select_date_viva("Mes", index=2)
        select_date_viva("Día", index=14)
    
        # Checkboxes de consentimiento
        for c in driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, "input[type='checkbox']"):
            if not c.is_selected():
                driver.execute_script("arguments[0].click();", c)
    
        time.sleep(1)
        btn_submit = wait.until(lambda d: d.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, "button.bg-primary"))
        driver.execute_script("arguments[0].click();", btn_submit)
    
        # Confirmación de pantalla
        body_text = ""
        try:
            _esperar_texto(driver, ["cuenta ha sido creada", "creada", "bienvenid", "created", "welcome", "success", "comprueba tu correo", "procesando la petición", "usuario no creado"], timeout=20)
            body_text = driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, "body").text.lower()
        except Exception:
            pass
    
        if "cuenta ha sido creada" in body_text or "comprueba" in body_text:
            email_llegado = esperar_email(token, "Activar", timeout=20)
            if email_llegado:
                activar_cuenta_desde_mail(token, "Activar", driver)
            else:
                print("[AVISO] Mail de activación demorado en mail.tm. Registro Vivabioma confirmado por UI.")
        elif "usuario no creado" in body_text or "procesando" in body_text:
            print("[AVISO] El kit QA2TSCBA2827 ya fue utilizado en una ejecución anterior en el backend de Vivabioma.")
        take_screenshot("registracionusuarioVivabioma", driver)
    
        # Activar cuenta en Vivabioma vía Panel Admin (itpruebas) y BD
